secrets.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Key id of an App Store Connect API key with App Manager access.
secrets.generate: App Store Connect > Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API > Team Keys > +

secrets.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID
secrets.description: Issuer id shown above the keys list.

secrets.name: MATCH_GIT_URL
secrets.description: HTTPS URL of the private repo that stores encrypted certificates and profiles.
secrets.generate: create an empty private repository, e.g. github.com/you/certificates

secrets.name: MATCH_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Passphrase that encrypts the match repo.
secrets.generate: chosen the first time you run fastlane match; store it in a password manager
secrets.rotate: only by re-encrypting the repo (fastlane match change_password)

secrets.name: MATCH_GIT_BASIC_AUTHORIZATION
secrets.description: base64 of 'username:token' for a token that can read the match repo.
secrets.generate: GitHub fine-grained token with read access to the certificates repo; then: printf 'user:token' | base64

secrets.name: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64
secrets.generate: keytool -genkey ... (see next steps); then base64 -i upload-keystore.jks | pbcopy

secrets.name: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Store password of the upload keystore.

secrets.name: ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS
secrets.description: Alias of the upload key, usually 'upload'.

secrets.name: PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
secrets.description: JSON key of a Google Cloud service account invited to Play Console with release permissions.
secrets.generate: Google Cloud > IAM > Service accounts > create > Keys > JSON; Play Console > Users and permissions > invite the service account email with 'Release to testing tracks' (and production if needed).
